scoped_factual_legal_support.summary: All50 frozen rows are addressed. EO14122 supplies theApril12 2024 prospective formal endpoint; federal workforce duties are broader than vaccination and immediate mask measures. Known performance must be retained even where exact first completion remains unknown.

components.finding: M21-15 datedJanuary24 2021 actually issues model safety guidance and confirms TaskForce operation. Section2(b) performance occurred withinJanuary20–24; a missing exact earlier completion date must not erase known issuance. Initial guidance is distinct from the ongoing section4(e) mission.

M21-15 page5 says CDC is developing/submitting a testing plan and promises guidance when available; it does not prove final section5 delivery. M21-25 page2 corroborates agency plans completed/implemented byJune10, without identifying every section4(f) transmittal.

EO14099 sections2–3 revokes14042/14043 effectiveMay12 2023 at12:01amEDT; it does not revoke13991. DOTAugust24 2023 page4 expressly says13991 remains in effect; pages6–7 retain condition-dependent masking while ending screening and general official-travel restrictions.

EO13991 section4 creates an institution and ongoing guidance mission. EO14122 revocation/Coordinator transfer does not eliminate saved independent agency powers. EO14148 contains no13991 revival and does not list14122 for revocation.

material_gaps: Actual prompt consultations, nonfederal options communications, every agency section4(f) report, final testing-plan transmittal and OSTP/NSTC assessment are not supplied.
Exact first full section2(b) named-official performance remains narrower than known guidance issuance; distinguish known interval from unknown event.
whole_lifecycle_completeness.qualification: The named gaps do not withdraw independently supported formal endpoints or known performance intervals. Complete implementation chronology is a different question from the prospective force of a formally revoked EO.

supported_formal_whole_order_endpoint.scope: Prospective force under this EO formally ended. Earlier one-time performance, historical acts and independent law remain separate.
